verdict.rationale: Cookieless tracking is a fair axis for a product analytics tool, but the evidence pack never mentions cookies, cookieless modes, or consent-banner avoidance. The privacy items cover GDPR deletion/retrieval APIs and EU data residency, which are adjacent compliance features rather than cookie-free tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track product usage without third-party cookies so I can minimize or avoid cookie consent banners
